items.docs: Retrieves balance information for up to 100 addresses on the same blockchain in a single efficient request. Partial failures are supported - if some addresses fail, successful results are still returned with error details for failed addresses.

params.name: chain
params.description: Network identifier (bitcoin_mainnet, ethereum_mainnet, ethereum_classic_mainnet, xrp_mainnet, solana_mainnet, etc.)

params.name: address
params.description: Blockchain address to query (format depends on chain)

items.docs: Retrieves native currency balance and token holdings for a single blockchain address. Token balances are automatically included for chains that support them (Ethereum, Solana, XRP, Avalanche, etc.).
Returns metadata for all blockchain networks supported by this service, including chain identifiers, names, native units, and token support capabilities.
